evidence.locator: Fig. 2d,e and caption; Fig. 3c and caption; Extended Data Fig. 10k and caption; Supplementary Methods linked by the captions
evidence.supports: The original paper evaluates facial-feature linear decoding/reconstruction, familiarity-decoding accuracy and face-identity classification. Extended Data Fig. 10k explicitly uses 30 feature-matched faces, 50-ms windows with 10-ms steps, and half the trials for training and the remaining half for testing. These are original ordered tasks distinct from coding-axis geometry; exact active endpoint and numeric baseline remain unrecovered.

evidence.locator: Supplementary Methods: Face feature decoding and reconstruction; Familiarity decoding; Face identity decoding; Additional figure legends
evidence.supports: Original feature decoding uses repeat-averaged rates, linear regression trained on 999 unfamiliar faces and tested on the omitted face plus familiar faces. Familiarity uses linear-SVM leave-one-out evaluation with 36-unfamiliar balancing and ten repetitions. Identity uses random half-trial train/test averages and multiclass linear SVMs with twenty repetitions. Panel-specific numeric baseline, source split realizations and implementation still require recovery.

target.description: Predict original facial-feature vectors from the original repeat-averaged neural responses, separately for unfamiliar and familiar face queries under Figure 2d. The selected output is feature-vector correlation, not familiarity/identity classification, geometry separation or reconstruction MSE.

dataset.description: Original response and face-feature arrays released in Zenodo 10460607 version 1. Exact Figure 2d archive member/face/neuron/time identities and publication equivalence remain unresolved; merely having the axis-geometry archive does not authenticate the decoding inputs.

cohort.description: All original AM, PR and TP Figure 2d neural populations, source animals/sessions, 1,000 unfamiliar faces and 36 familiar faces. Recover exact neurons and stimulus-set/repetition joins; AM134/PR72/TP197 geometry counts and PR76 in another panel cannot be silently adopted as the decoder roster.

split.description: Use all 1,000 source leave-one-unfamiliar-face-out folds: 999 unfamiliar training faces, one omitted unfamiliar query and 36 familiar queries in every fold. Preserve all ten identity-shuffled control repetitions and their mapping. No 964/36/36 geometry sampling, half-trial identity split or newly selected face/animal holdout is substituted. Exact original control draws are unresolved.

inputs.description: Use repeat-averaged original responses at each source population/time window and training-face feature coordinates, with exact coordinate identities/order. Familiar feature targets remain operator scoring inputs; unfamiliar targets are exposed across the original LOOCV folds. Exact source features and response-to-face joins are unresolved.

preprocessing.description: Original decoder uses repeat-averaged firing rates, 50-ms sliding windows stepped 10 ms and source feature standard-deviation scaling. Recover the scaling population, temporal boundaries and neuron/repetition selections; the geometry component full-matrix RMS normalization is not decoder parity.

metric.description: Pearson correlation across actual versus decoded feature coordinates for each face-vector pair, higher is better. Preserve 1,000 unfamiliar values and 1,000 by 36 familiar values at every population/time/control coordinate; do not replace with face-level MSE or absolute correlation.

aggregation.description: Recover original Figure 2d reduction over familiar query folds, faces, cells/populations, time and ten shuffle repetitions and its uncertainty. Retain all per-face/per-fold correlations and all source curves; no new pooled scalar or favorable region/time subset. The 36,000 familiar predictions are not independent faces or animals.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 2d original time-resolved face-vector Pearson correlation, retaining familiar/unfamiliar curves and all ten identity-shuffled controls

published_baseline.description: Original Figure 2d linear-regression decoder is the relevant author comparator. Its complete numerical curves and original panel reduction remain unrecovered; no geometry RMSE or other decoder panel supplies this baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No reproduced author score for the original decoding candidate is established. The existing descriptive/reference-reconstruction implementation remains calibration only and cannot supply this baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful effect cannot be justified until one original decoding endpoint, its metric scale, source baseline and original sampling design are bound. No generic margin is assigned.

uncertainty.method: Recover the original evaluation units and dependence structure, then predeclare paired uncertainty for the bound original decoder comparison; no confidence threshold is invented.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Depends on the selected original decoding task: animal/session sampling with trials, faces, windows and repeated splits nested; exact hierarchy unresolved.
uncertainty.rationale: Repeated folds, random subsamples, overlapping windows or decoder repetitions are not independent biological replicates. Exact original protocol and eligible units must be recovered before admission.
